scope: All 40 answers read in full, including long staff-training/Sensitive Uses and research answers; all 39 eligible source answers considered for controls. One blank answer supplies no evidence.
selection_limitations: Selected aggregated governance controls are substantively evidenced; this is not an exhaustive enumeration of every technical feature, research grant or policy mention. Repeated stages are same-control disclosures, not independent company observations. Research-only future tools, generic yes responses, inapplicable claims and question presuppositions do not establish operational controls. All four stages applicable; no all-zero placeholder required.
traceability_limitations: No public URLs, certifications, named reports or dated incident artifacts were externally checked. Artifact access unclear, artifact_url blank; ratings capped2 even where named references or dated claims occur. Public availability in source is a disclosure claim, not independently confirmed access.
link_method: Links coded only where the source explicitly assigns operation/checking of the same control and links findings or verified fixes with corrective action. One short quote/link_quote need not reproduce every supporting sentence; row_ids and per-unit notes identify full within-control evidence. Responsibility deliberately0 for frontier thresholds when no final owner for that specific control disclosed.
interpretation: No claim of human review, legal compliance or governance effectiveness. Public disclosure measures do not establish internal practice absence or operating success. Full report-level independent adjudication/human validation remains pending.

review_scope: Full semantic reading of all89 source answers in untruncated sequential batches. Source report and eligibility list preserved. No peer labels or automated proposed scores consulted.
selection: Aggregated eight substantive recurring controls across applicable stages. Units support a documented selection of controls, not an exhaustive enumeration of every control or research initiative. Same control IDs reused across stages only on substantive within-report evidence; no cross-period identity inference.
limitations: AI review requires independent human validation and report-control adjudication. No external URL, certification, system card, research paper, case record or internal artifact was inspected; all component scores capped at2, artifact_access unclear. Self-reported operation does not prove effectiveness. Blank/administrative answers do not establish absence or inapplicability. Draft September2026 Humanist Code, prospective benchmark expansion, planned outputs and customer-configurable capabilities were not treated as universally operational controls. Descriptive dates and counts remain unverified claims. Research, public benefit, literacy and standards participation sections were read, but not all constitute a distinct accountable governance control. Links require explicit same-control relations, assessed across eligible answers when aggregated; no linkage inferred from a stakeholder roster or mere co-occurrence.

full_read_statement: Read all 89 questions and answers in full in source order (indices 0–88), including every eligible answer, administrative answers and blanks. selection: Four aggregated, salient control-stage units selected after full report review; selected controls are not an exhaustive inventory. Preparedness control matched across design and deployment on explicit common framework, capability/safeguard reports and Safety Advisory Group process.
limits: AI semantic coding only; independent human review/adjudication remains required. External URLs, named artifacts, framework versions, dated incident reports, system cards and certification claims were not externally inspected or validated. Component scores capped at 2; no public artifact access claimed and no effectiveness/compliance inference. No evidence here establishes no internal practice. Current mechanisms distinguished from research funding commitments and future intentions.
